↗ See something you like? Bring it into your next edit. How it works
  1. Open a reference. Watch the example and find the part you like.
  2. Pick your handoff. Copy reference opens the saved example and its context, whether it’s yours or another creator’s. Choose Add notes & copy when you want to specify a moment or what to borrow.
  3. Paste into your editing chat. Add a line such as “Use the opening card motion with my footage.” Use the copy icon beside + for one reference. To combine examples, select them with +, then Review & copy.

Save a source link with Add reference, then use Analyze in chat to add visual context. Your finished edits can be added from chat. The + saves a selection here; it doesn’t send a chat message. Show me an example ↗
